findings.session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing a safe space for the student to discuss school re-entry without sharing private family details. The main barrier identified was uncertainty regarding school procedures and home circumstances affecting attendance.
findings.primary_concern: Uncertainty about school procedures and inability to plan ahead due to home situation changes.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed next step: Check the first-week timetable with a named school contact.
Student preference: Keep private family details out of records/shared information.

next_steps: Student to attempt checking the timetable with a school contact.
Mentor to verify if external support eligibility has been checked.
uncertainties: Whether the student can complete the between-session task without private details hindering progress.
Status of any external support applications (none confirmed).
findings.conclusion: The session established a plan to check the timetable. No external support was delivered or confirmed. The main barrier (uncertainty) remains unresolved as the student noted the wider barrier has not disappeared. Evidence supports that the mentoring activity occurred, but attendance improvement is unknown.
